message: CRM 1.2.4 is available with the latest desktop features and production configuration.
releaseNotes: Secure single-device login asks the active computer before transferring an account.
Approved devices restore the existing task timer and break state without creating a duplicate timer.
Today's desktop timesheet displays work and break segments in chronological order.
Selected project, task and dashboard view remain selected while the app refreshes.
Includes the latest desktop source used by the current CRM workspace.
